description: AI Narrative Visual by Astral Insights instantly transforms your Power BI data into clear, natural language insights powered by Azure OpenAI. What It Does: Connects to your Fabric data sources and generates AI-powered narrative summaries of your analytics—turning complex charts and metrics into easy-to-understand business stories. Who It's For: Business executives, analysts, and decision-makers who need to quickly understand data without deep technical expertise. Perfect for teams creating executive dashboards, automated reports, or stakeholder presentations. Problem It Solves: Stop spending hours manually writing data summaries and explanations. Eliminate the communication gap between data teams and business leaders. Make your analytics accessible to everyone—no more "what does this chart mean?" Key Benefits: - AI narrative generation from your data - No data collection—everything stays in your Microsoft environment - Works seamlessly with Power BI and Fabric - Enterprise-grade security via Entra ID Transform raw data into actionable insights in seconds, not hours.
